jamal_procure: Hey @vendor_rep_tk — quick check. We have a scheduled top-up window for eu-west next week but the lead time on the quoted H100s looks tight. Can you confirm ETA and whether we can split shipment for partial immediate replacement?
vendor_rep_tk: Hi Jamal — under review. Current ETA for the batch is 8–10 business days. We can do a split: 20 units this shipment, rest in t+14. Need sign-off on partial RMA handling and who covers crossdock fees.
lia_logistics: If we split, customs will want separate AWBs. That adds broker fees. What's the cost delta?
vendor_rep_tk: Estimated extra: ~€420 per split (broker + AWB + handling). Can provide consolidated paperwork to reduce customs hits.
alex_dev: heads-up — cluster hot pool is down to 12% spare, we’ll hit degraded scheduling if top-up slips. Can we prioritize air vs sea for the immediate split?
sophia_ops: +1 on priority. For eu-west low-latency customers we need air. Accept higher freight if we get sooner. Also need clear RMA flow if any DOA.
vendor_rep_tk: Air is available for the 20-unit slice. Extra freight ~€6.5k. For DOA/RMA, we can provide temporary loaners while we process returns, but that's limited to 5 units.
jamal_procure: Can you do a partial warranty swap? We prefer depot repair to avoid cross-border returns — reduces time. What’s the SLA on depot turnaround?
vendor_rep_tk: Depot repair SLA ~ 7 business days. If we dispatch replacements under advanced exchange, we need a credit card on file for temporary invoice.
lia_logistics: On advanced exchange, we require an RMA authorization PDF and a consolidated manifest. rma_bot: RMA created: RMA-2025-0893. Status: pending vendor confirmation.
jamal_procure: Jamal here — new ask: can we get SKU-compatibility confirmation for the loaners? Past incident with firmware mismatch caused staging delays.
vendor_rep_tk: Loaners are H100-LQ revB — firmware baseline v2.1. We will flash to match customer image before handoff.
alex_dev: note: we have a set of older driver pins on some nodes; we’ll need to schedule a short maintenance window for the swap. 30–45m per rack.
sophia_ops: Also need insurance note: who covers transit damage for split AWB? Vendor or Redwood?
vendor_rep_tk: Vendor covers transit until handoff at Redwood’s nominated dock. After that, Redwood's forwarder assumes liability. We can escalate insured value if you confirm amount.
jamal_procure: Ok lock: 20 units air now (advanced-exchange loaners up to 5), remainder sea t+14. Redwood will cover crossdock once docked; vendor covers transit before dock. Jamal to send PO. Please confirm updated proforma with split charges + AWB list.
vendor_rep_tk: Will send updated proforma by EOD with separate line items: 20x H100 air, freight €6.5k, split handling €420, loaner program note, and depot SLA.
lia_logistics: Also add: inbound doc to include Harmonized Tariff Numbers and "temporary import" markers to avoid duty. Include contact: Lia Logistics <lia@redwood.ai>.
jamal_procure: sending PO in 30m. rma_bot: RMA-2025-0893 updated: vendor_confirmed=true, shipment_plan=split_air_then_sea.
sophia_ops: Thanks team. Alex will coordinate maintenance windows once ETA firm. Keep thread for any customs exceptions. :thumbsup:
